newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber flat in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber flat in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were flat in late trading on Thursday on poor demand, traders said.
"I don't hear any deals taking place today. Buyers still stay away from the market and holidays in Malaysia and Singapore have also dampened the overall sentiment," said one trader.
Traders also said they expected market sentiment to stay poor on Friday since most players in the region would be attending an industry function at the Thai rubber centre of Hat Yai.
"Let's see what will happen on Monday. It's kind of useless to talk about trading now as sentiment is weak," said one trader.

Traders said SIR20 offer prices were quoted at 46.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for June/July shipment, at 46.00 fob Padang, at 46.00 fob Surabaya, at 45.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi and at 46.25 fob Palembang.
Some traders said that prices could fall to as low as 45.00 U.S. cents/lb in a few weeks because of the prolonged poor demand.
